description: Lesson i3 mistake: hal-tim-irq with PSC 72 / ARR 1000 (the '- 1' forgotten) - PB12 492.66 Hz instead of 500 Hz
expect: 72 MHz; TIM4 PSC 72, ARR 1000 on TIMXCLK1 = 72 MHz: an update every 73 x 1001 = 73073 timer clocks = 1014.903 us (985.31 Hz) instead of 1.000 ms. Each TIM4 interrupt toggles PB12 push-pull: 1.014903 ms high / 1.014903 ms low = 492.66 Hz (-1.47 %). Every 500th interrupt toggles PC13 (on-board LED, active low, starts off): 507.451 ms on / 507.451 ms off. The CPU sleeps in __WFI(). No UART.

circuit: PB12: logic analyzer probe (no load needed)
